paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 3.4, with a change of 7.44% from the prior close and a change of -28.83% over a window of 22 sessions. The price is as of October 15, 2026.

There are 4 new news items in the last 24 hours, including a report from NucNet that the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has issued a preliminary recommendation supporting a combined licence for four planned Westinghouse AP1000 reactors at Fermi America's Project Matador. Other news items include reports of insider sales by major shareholders, including Toby Neugebauer, who sold shares on October 13 and 14.

There have been recent SEC filings, including an 8-K form filed on October 16, 2026, announcing a Limited Waiver and Amendment No. 1 to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd. There have also been Form 4 and Form 144 filings, indicating insider transactions and proposed sales of restricted shares.
